hero.title: Science and Technology in Gupta Age
hero.description: An analytical exploration of India's intellectual zenith, covering advancements in mathematics, astronomy, and metallurgy during the classical period.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: Key intellectual milestones between 4th and 6th century CE.

cards.details: Accession of Chandragupta I; consolidation of the Gupta Empire providing stability for scientific inquiry.
Aryabhata completes Aryabhatiya, introducing the concept of zero and calculating the value of Pi.
Varahamihira authors Brihat Samhita and Pancha Siddhantika, cementing Gupta legacy in astronomy.

items.title: V.A.A.S
items.decryption: V (Varahamihira - Astronomy), A (Aryabhata - Mathematics), A (Amarasimha - Lexicography/Amara Kosha), S (Susruta/Charaka lineage - Medicine)

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Do not confuse Gupta scientific advancements with Vedic science; these were empirical and evidence-based.
Avoid attributing the invention of Zero directly to Aryabhata; he popularized its use in positional notation, but the concept existed in the Bakshali manuscript period.
Ensure you differentiate between the Pancha Siddhantika (Astronomy) and Panchatantra (Fables).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Sectors

  • Mathematics & Astronomy
  • Medical Sciences
  • Metallurgy
  • Linguistics & Lexicography

Intellectual Giants

  • Aryabhata (Aryabhatiya)
  • Varahamihira (Brihat Samhita)
  • Dhanvantari (Medicine)
  • Amarasimha (Amara Kosha)

Scientific Branches Overview

  • Mathematics: Aryabhata calculated Pi to 3.1416. Usage of the decimal system and place-value notation evolved significantly.
  • Astronomy: Varahamihira argued that the Earth is spherical. Identification of Rahu and Ketu as eclipses.
  • Medicine: Expansion of Ayurveda; Charaka Samhita and Sushruta Samhita were finalized and systematized.
  • Metallurgy: The Mehrauli Iron Pillar is a testament to the advanced rust-resistant iron technology of the period.
